class.name: MarkupUI
class.brief_description: Control that builds child UI nodes from XML and a small SCSS/CSS subset.
class.description: [MarkupUI] can be added to a scene and rebuilt from inline XML/SCSS strings or external files. XML tags map to common Control classes such as [Label], [Button], [VBoxContainer], [HBoxContainer], [PanelContainer], and [LineEdit]. Styles support tag selectors, [code].class[/code] selectors, and [code]#id[/code] selectors.

method.name: load_from_files
method.description: Sets file paths and rebuilds the generated UI.

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Clears generated children, parses styles, and rebuilds the UI from the current sources.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the UI rebuilds when entering the tree and when inline source changes while inside the tree.
Optional path to a SCSS/CSS style file.
Optional path to an XML UI file.
